extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication: antimicrobial mechanism of action is not directly tested; biosynthetic COM-domain mechanism is recorded as context only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local source supports phenotype-level antimicrobial activity for the linear hexapeptide, nonapeptide, and heptapeptide through MIC measurements, but it does not test a direct antimicrobial mechanism of action.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: linear hexapeptide; linear nonapeptide; linear heptapeptide
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/growth inhibition supports activity phenotype only; no membrane, binding, microscopy, omics, or enzyme-target assay is present in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly studies COM-domain reprogramming of the plipastatin NRPS biosynthetic assembly line as a production mechanism for novel lipopeptides; this is not evidence for the antimicrobial killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: plipastatin NRPS COM-domain engineered lipopeptide production
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biosynthetic mechanism should not be promoted to direct AMP mechanism-of-action evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Source material supports antimicrobial MIC phenotype and COM-domain biosynthetic mechanism only.
